integrity.computational_evidence: exact fraction assertions corroborate, not substitute for, infinite theorem

scientific_limitations: Only pure equilibrium weighted edge disagreement, not combined polarization-disagreement or total edge costs.
Requires undirected nonnegative edges, strictly positive diagonal stubbornness, and independent finite closed edge-weight intervals.
Box-corner existence does not provide a polynomial-time combinatorial algorithm.
Further specialist comparison of broad matrix-fractional optimization results may affect publication priority.
title: A bang–bang theorem for minimizing equilibrium disagreement under independent tie-strength bounds
